component.name: Beacon of St. Joseph
component.summary: Spyro-inspired 3D platformer set in St. Joseph, Michigan

description.p: Soar, glide, and horn-charge through the brick streets of downtown St. Joseph, Michigan. Discover iconic Lake Michigan landmarks including State Street, Lake Bluff Park, the Maid of the Mist Fountain, Silver Beach Carousel, the North Pier Twin Lighthouses, and the St. Joseph River Swing Bridge.
Step through shimmering harbor portals to explore nearby landmark realms and collect six lost lighthouse artifacts to relight the harbor beacon.
Initial release with Downtown St. Joseph Hub and three landmark portal realms.
